object.attr: analysis: the definitions give an object ID this form, but the docs say only that Mellon creates IDs in it. DOC-01 and DOC-1 would be two files for one number (review Q22), and an object named otherwise escapes the next object number.
object.description: If an object's object ID isn't the document ID, a hyphen and an object number written without leading zeros, Mellon shall report a validation error.
